newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: AND INT PUB FINALISES MAP FIRM BUY.
newsitem.headline: AND INT PUB FINALISES MAP FIRM BUY.

text.p: AND International Publishers Plc said on Wednesday it had finalised its acquisition of British firm European Map Graphics Ltd.
AND paid 350,000 pounds sterling in cash and issued 128,000 shares to certain vendors of EMG, the company said.
AND said in April it had agreed to buy EMG, which provides cartographic services and small-scale cartographic databases. EMG had 1996 turnover of around a million pounds.

"The EMG technology for producing maps will significantly strengthen the AND technology division, especially the capacity to produce electronic atlases and atlas parts in encyclopedias," AND said in a statement.
AND -- listed in Amsterdam and on London's Alternative Investment Market (AIM) -- specialises in electronic publishing, mapping and identification systems.
